description: This file defines the TransferEventType enum which represents different types of transfer events such as proposal, acceptance, withdrawal, and rejection within the transfer service module of the Fineract project.

classes.name: TransferEventType
classes.description: Enum representing the types of transfer events with associated integer codes and string identifiers, along with helper methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer code associated with the transfer event type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the transfer event type.

methods.name: isAcceptance
methods.description: Checks if the current transfer event type is acceptance.
